verifyBanner.text: Please confirm your email address. We sent a link to {{email}}.
verifyBanner.sent: We sent a new link. Check your inbox.

home.title: Home
home.statusSetup: Let's get your website ready. Setup takes about 10 minutes.

content.title: Content
content.emptyBody: Once your website is set up, your first articles will appear here, ready for your review.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.emptyBody: After setup, we'll plan your articles and show their publishing dates here.
calendar.description: Drag an article to another day to change its publishing date. The time stays the same.
calendar.newDateHint: The publishing time stays the same.

results.title: Results
results.emptyBody: Once your first articles are live, you'll see how often Google shows them and where they rank.

account.title: Your account
account.name: Name
account.languageHint: Used for the dashboard and emails we send you.

impersonation.text: You are viewing Kitisel as {{name}} ({{email}}). This view is read-only.

billing.title: Plan and billing
billing.description: Choose your plan and pay by card or bank transfer. Each payment opens one period (a month or a year).
billing.notAllowed: Only the account owner or an admin can make payments.
billing.unavailableBody: Payment methods aren’t set up yet. To get a plan, write to us from the contact page.

current.title: Your plan: {{plan}}
current.paid: Your paid period ends on {{date}}. We send a renewal reminder 3 days before.
current.complimentary: This plan was set up for you by the Kitisel team.
current.complimentaryUntil: This plan was set up for you by the Kitisel team until {{date}}.
current.trial: You have 3 articles a month and 1 site. Choose a plan to raise your limits.

return.failedBody: Your card wasn’t charged. Check your card details and try again, or pay by bank transfer.
return.paidBody: Your plan is active. We also emailed you a payment summary.
return.waitingBody: Waiting for confirmation from PayTR. This usually takes a few seconds; you can close the page and your plan will open once it’s confirmed.

transfer.title: Waiting for your bank transfer
transfer.body: Send the payment for the {{plan}} plan ({{interval}}) to the account below.
transfer.referenceNote: Be sure to enter {{reference}} as the payment reference; we use this code to match your payment.
transfer.rateNote: {{usd}} was converted at the CBRT selling rate at the time of the order ({{rate}} TRY).
transfer.approvalNote: Your plan opens once the payment reaches our account (usually within 1 business day), and we’ll email you.
transfer.created: Your transfer details are ready. You don’t need to do anything else after paying.

card.title: Secure payment
card.body: Enter your card details in PayTR’s secure payment form. Kitisel never sees or stores your card details.

form.title: Choose a plan
form.body: Prices are in US dollars (USD). VAT is added for billing addresses in Turkey.
form.renewBody: The new period starts when the current one ends. To change plans, write to us from the contact page.
form.taxIdHint: Leave it empty to be invoiced as a consumer.

methodHint.card: Credit or debit card. Your plan opens as soon as the payment is confirmed.
methodHint.bank_transfer: You send the payment to our bank account. Your plan opens once it arrives.

form.transferCurrency: Which account will you send to?

currencyHint.USD: You send the amount in dollars.
currencyHint.TRY: The amount is converted to TRY at the CBRT selling rate.

form.tryNote: The TRY amount is calculated at today’s CBRT rate and shown in the next step.
form.noAutoRenew: There are no automatic charges. We send a renewal reminder 3 days before your period ends.
form.accept:
I have read and accept the Distance Sales Agreement and the 
Pre-Information Form
. Cancellation and refund policy
form.secure: Payments are processed by PayTR, licensed by the Central Bank of Turkey, with 3D Secure.

billing.settingsBody: See your plan, renew or upgrade it, and check your payment history.

test.title: Test mode
test.body: Bank details aren’t set yet, so a sample test account is shown. Don’t send real money to it; you can try the flow by approving the order in the admin panel. For a real account, add BANK_ACCOUNT_HOLDER and the IBANs to the .env file.
